Description

Xiaomi 4K Monitor A27Ui 27" UHD IPS USB-C Monitor

The Xiaomi 4K Monitor A27Ui is designed for users who need significantly more visual detail and workspace than a conventional Full HD display. Its 27-inch 4K UHD panel delivers a sharp 3840 × 2160 resolution, providing excellent clarity for spreadsheets, web development, photo editing, content creation, office applications, and high-resolution multimedia.

The IPS panel technology provides wide viewing angles and consistent color reproduction across the screen. With broad sRGB and DCI-P3 color-gamut coverage, the A27Ui is also suited to workflows where accurate and consistent color representation is important.

A major advantage of the A27Ui is its USB Type-C connectivity, allowing compatible laptops and devices to transmit video while receiving power through a single cable. The monitor also provides conventional HDMI and DisplayPort connectivity, making it easy to integrate into desktop PCs, laptops, workstations, and multi-device environments.

Its ergonomic stand provides additional flexibility for users who spend long periods working at a desk, while eye-comfort technologies help make extended daily use more comfortable.

  • 27-inch 4K UHD desktop monitor
  • Sharp 3840 × 2160 resolution
  • IPS panel for consistent colors and wide viewing angles
  • 60Hz refresh rate for smooth everyday productivity
  • 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio
  • Wide sRGB and DCI-P3 color-gamut coverage
  • High color accuracy suitable for creative workflows
  • Supports high color-depth reproduction
  • USB Type-C connectivity

  • Suitable for PCs, laptops, workstations, and multimedia devices
